`rasterio` needs the system library `libexpat.so.1`. Let me check if it exists anywhere or can be installed.

```python
import subprocess, glob, os

# Search for libexpat on the system
found = subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", "find / -name 'libexpat*' 2>/dev/null"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("libexpat candidates:\n", found.stdout)

# Check apt availability
print(subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", "which apt-get yum apk 2>/dev/null"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
```
